name: Path Dimension / co-VC Dimension (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For n>=3, half-intervals satisfy $\mathrm P(\mathcal I_n)=n-1$ and $\operatorname{coVC}(\mathcal I_n)=2$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $\operatorname{coVC}(\mathcal S_n)=n$ while $\mathrm P(\mathcal S_n)=2\ (n\ge3)$.
proof: In the first listed family the ratio of path dimension to the other parameter tends to infinity. In the singleton family, for n>=3 the other parameter grows linearly in n while path dimension is two. Thus neither universal affine upper bound holds. This does not assert functional incomparability.
